components.name: Native actions
components.description: Schematic primary and secondary actions. Production uses x-filament::button with its generated primary palette and native loading, disabled, and hover states; do not copy preview CSS into the app.
components.css: .ds-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.ds-actions button{min-height:48px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgb(26 16 64 / 15%);background:white;color:#1a1040;font:500 14px Poppins,sans-serif}.ds-actions .primary{background:#5b3e9e;color:white}.ds-actions button:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-actions button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #5b3e9e;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Native field
components.description: A white editable surface with a persistent label. Production retains Filament field wrappers, validation, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#1a1040;font:500 14px Poppins,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:48px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:8px 12px;background:white;color:#1a1040;border:1px solid rgb(26 16 64 / 20%);border-radius:8px;font:400 16px Poppins,sans-serif}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:rgb(26 16 64 / 65%)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #5b3e9e;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: Mouse28's established direction is Park-Day Dispatch: navy framing, cream editorial surfaces, gold details, purple actions, and real family stories. The public site feels like a carefully assembled trip-planning folio. The administration area is the editorial workspace behind that publication.
keyCharacteristics: Navy framing and cream editorial surfaces
dos: Do preserve keyboard access, readable contrast, meaningful headings, visible focus, mobile sizing, and reduced motion.
Do use the existing Vite entry points and shared Blade components; keep third-party CSS overrides in the admin theme.
Do verify desktop and mobile dashboard layouts, a resource table and editor, login, and custom subscriber screens after shared theme changes.
Do keep public and admin fonts and core palette aligned while allowing different information density.
donts: Don't hide all Filament page headings globally or override every label with a brand color.
Don't replace native controls, authorization, MFA, or editorial workflows to achieve a visual effect.
Don't use decorative gold for small text on light backgrounds, external font CDNs, invented metrics, or production data as test fixtures.
